zh_cn.create_biotech.ponder.allay_port_scene_1: 悦灵驿站可以用来远程派送包裹
在界面中设置本站地址
悦灵驿站会自动拉取下方打包机或容器中的包裹，并派出悦灵快递员送往指定悦灵驿站
在界面中可以配置悦灵快递员是否返航
悦灵快递员运输没有距离限制，甚至可以跨越维度
zh_cn.create_biotech.ponder.allay_port_s_21db7: 悦灵快递员可以指定玩家为运输目标
在地址栏中使用"@玩家"来匹配玩家

en_us.create_biotech.ponder.allay_port_scene_1: Cargo Allay Stations can be used to deliver packages remotely.
Set this station's address in its interface.
Cargo Allay Stations automatically pull packages from the Packager or container below and dispatch an Allay Courier to the specified Cargo Allay Station.
The interface lets you configure whether the Allay Courier returns after delivery.
Allay Couriers have no delivery range limit and can even travel between dimensions.
en_us.create_biotech.ponder.allay_port_s_21db7: Allay Couriers can target players for delivery.
Use "@player" in the address field to target a player.

zh_cn.create_biotech.ponder.bio_packager_scene: 生物打包机会从其附着的库存中提取装有生物的纸箱并释放到其上方
zh_cn.create_biotech.ponder.bio_packager_s_fe8: 生物打包机会自动提取附着库存中的纸箱，并捕捉被动态结构杀死的生物

en_us.create_biotech.ponder.bio_packager_scene: The Bio Packager pulls boxes containing creatures from its attached inventory and releases them above itself.
en_us.create_biotech.ponder.bio_packager_s_fe8: The Bio Packager automatically pulls cardboard boxes from its attached inventory and captures creatures killed by moving contraptions.

zh_cn.create_biotech.ponder.bone_ratchet.text_: 骨质棘轮只接受一种方向的旋转
接受反方向应力时，他会卡死整个应力网络

en_us.create_biotech.ponder.bone_ratchet.text_: The Bone Ratchet only accepts rotation in one direction.
When given stress from the opposite direction, it jams the entire kinetic network.

zh_cn.create_biotech.ponder.creeper_blast_cham: 苦力怕爆破室 介绍
这是一个苦力怕爆破室
它可以高效批量地执行粉碎配方
或者...你想来点更劲爆的？
苦力怕爆破室 搭建
结构支持3种尺寸
结构顶面中心需为动力冲压机
结构底面中心需为生物打包机
结构的框架由防爆机壳搭成
除了顶面和底面的任意面中心可以被替换为防爆玻璃
除此之外，每个结构还必须包括一个爆破室核心
以及两个任意大小的防爆保险库（连接的保险库算做一个）
结构成型以后，顶面的棱会被自动替换为链式传动箱
使用扳手可以在机壳和传动箱之间切换，但是需要保证能够剩下的传动箱足以驱动所有冲压机
苦力怕爆破室 运作
爆炸室核心可以通过纸箱输入和输出苦力怕
最大的爆破室最多可以有9个苦力怕同时工作
通入应力...
每有一只苦力怕，爆破室就会提取输入保险库中的一组物品，执行粉碎轮的粉碎配方，输出到输出保险库
右键长按保险库可以调整其为输入或输出
苦力怕爆破室 过载
苦力怕爆破室最高接受128rpm的转速
超过128rpm的转速会使其进入过载状态
不要长时间过载，除非你想引起一次足以炸毁你基地的大爆炸！
苦力怕爆破室 高压聚爆
向爆破室中输入高压苦力怕...
可以将配方调整为“高压聚爆”模式
“高压聚爆”模式有单独的配方，不再执行粉碎配方
当然，过载引起的爆炸烈度也会成倍增加

en_us.create_biotech.ponder.creeper_blast_cham: Creeper Blast Chamber Introduction
This is a Creeper Blast Chamber.
It can process Crushing Wheel recipes efficiently in bulk.
Or... are you looking for something more explosive?
Creeper Blast Chamber Assembly
The structure supports 3 different sizes.
The center of the top face must be a Mechanical Press.
The center of the bottom face must be a Bio Packager.
The frame of the structure is built from Explosion-Proof Casing.
The center block of any side face, except the top and bottom, can be replaced with Blast-Proof Glass.
In addition, every structure must include a Blast Chamber Core.
It also needs two Explosion-Proof Item Vaults of any size; connected vaults count as one.
After the structure forms, the top edges are automatically replaced with Encased Chain Drives.
You can use a Wrench to swap between casings and chain drives, but enough chain drives must remain to power every press.
Creeper Blast Chamber Operation
The Blast Chamber Core can input and output creepers using cardboard boxes.
The largest blast chamber can have up to 9 creepers working at once.
Apply rotational force...
For each creeper inside, the chamber takes one batch of items from the input vault, runs the matching Crushing Wheel recipe, and outputs the result to the output vault.
Hold right-click on a vault to switch it between input and output.
Creeper Blast Chamber Overload
The Creeper Blast Chamber can handle speeds up to 128 RPM.
Any speed above 128 RPM will send it into an overloaded state.
Do not overload it for too long, unless you want an explosion big enough to destroy your base!
Creeper Blast Chamber High-Pressure Implosion
Feed a high-pressure creeper into the chamber...
to switch recipes into High-Pressure Implosion mode.
High-Pressure Implosion mode has its own recipes and no longer runs Crushing Wheel recipes.
Of course, overload explosions also become much more powerful.

zh_cn.create_biotech.ponder.evoker_enchanting_: 这是一个简单的附魔流水线
在侧面标记一本附魔书...
它会将下方的书加工为附魔书（复印本）
无论是否在工作，打印机都需要输入水来保证鱿鱼存活
它可以将附魔书（复印本）附魔为可以使用的附魔书
通过经验泵向其输送附魔所需要的经验
附魔书的总等级越高，所需的经验越多，时间越长

en_us.create_biotech.ponder.evoker_enchanting_: This is a simple enchantment production line.
Mark an enchanted book on the side...
It will process the book below into an Enchanted Book (Copy).
Whether it is working or not, the printer needs a water supply to keep the squid alive.
This is an Evoker Enchanting Chamber.
It can turn copied enchanted books into usable enchanted books.
Supply it with the experience needed for enchanting through an Experience Pump.
The higher the total enchantment level, the more experience and time it requires.

zh_cn.create_biotech.ponder.experience_pump_sc: 经验泵可以用于在泵两端传递经验
输入端接受多种形式的经验
储罐或流体管道中的经验...
装有经验物品的储物方块...
在输入端安装分散网，可以吸引更远范围的经验球
zh_cn.create_biotech.ponder.experience_pump_s_: 输出端会向兼容的流体端点提供经验
也可以把经验输出到普通流体储罐或其他流体容器
输出端不能直接将经验转化为物品
你需要将经验通入经验母岩...
催化成熟的经验簇会自然掉落，它存储的经验值远高于经验颗粒

en_us.create_biotech.ponder.experience_pump_sc: The Experience Pump can transfer experience between its two ends.
The input side accepts many forms of experience.
Experience in tanks or fluid pipes...
Installing a Nozzle on the input side attracts experience orbs from farther away.
en_us.create_biotech.ponder.experience_pump_s_: The output side provides experience to compatible fluid endpoints.
It can also output experience to fluid tanks and other fluid containers.
The output side cannot turn experience directly into items.
You need to feed the experience into Budding Experience...
Catalyzed mature Experience Clusters drop naturally and store far more experience than Experience Nuggets.

zh_cn.create_biotech.ponder.ghast_helm_scene_1: 恶魂热气球装配站 组装
使用恶魂热气球装配站来组装你的恶魂热气球
使用强力胶粘合你的热气球
使用缓冲垫可以防止结构陷入地下
然后为热气球装配站接入红石...
再在装配站上方放一只恶魂...
靠近未充能的装配站或对绳索使用剪刀可以使结构解体
zh_cn.create_biotech.ponder.ghast_helm_s_29671: 恶魂热气球装配站 操纵
使用恶魂驾驶台来操控恶魂热气球
Alt 自动靠近附近未充能的装配站

en_us.create_biotech.ponder.ghast_helm_scene_1: Ghast Hot Air Balloon Assembly Station Assembly
Use a Ghast Hot Air Balloon Assembly Station to assemble your Ghast Hot Air Balloon.
Use Super Glue to glue your balloon together.
Buffer Pads can prevent the structure from getting stuck in the ground.
Then power the assembly station with redstone...
Then place a Ghast above the assembly station...
Approach an unpowered assembly station or use Shears on the rope to disassemble the structure.
en_us.create_biotech.ponder.ghast_helm_s_29671: Ghast Hot Air Balloon Assembly Station Controls
Use a Ghast Helm to control the Ghast Hot Air Balloon.
Alt automatically approaches a nearby unpowered assembly station.

zh_cn.create_biotech.ponder.ghast_hot_air_ball: 恶魂热气球装配站 组装
使用恶魂热气球装配站来组装你的恶魂热气球
使用强力胶粘合你的热气球
使用缓冲垫可以防止结构陷入地下
然后为热气球装配站接入红石...
再在装配站上方放一只恶魂...
靠近未充能的装配站或对绳索使用剪刀可以使结构解体
恶魂热气球装配站 操纵
使用恶魂驾驶台来操控恶魂热气球
Alt 自动靠近附近未充能的装配站

en_us.create_biotech.ponder.ghast_hot_air_ball: Ghast Hot Air Balloon Assembly Station Assembly
Use a Ghast Hot Air Balloon Assembly Station to assemble your Ghast Hot Air Balloon.
Use Super Glue to glue your balloon together.
Buffer Pads can prevent the structure from getting stuck in the ground.
Then power the assembly station with redstone...
Then place a Ghast above the assembly station...
Approach an unpowered assembly station or use Shears on the rope to disassemble the structure.
Ghast Hot Air Balloon Assembly Station Controls
Use a Ghast Helm to control the Ghast Hot Air Balloon.
Alt automatically approaches a nearby unpowered assembly station.

zh_cn.create_biotech.ponder.magma_belt_connect: 使用鼓风机烧炼物品比较占空间
它会自动烧炼其上方的物品，所需时间与鼓风机相同
它没有鼓风机的烧炼保护，记得在它被第二次燃烧前把它取走！

en_us.create_biotech.ponder.magma_belt_connect: Using a blower to smelt items takes a lot of space.
Use a Magma Cube Belt instead.
It automatically smelts items above it, taking the same amount of time as a blower.
It does not have a blower's smelting protection, so remember to remove the item before it burns a second time!

zh_cn.create_biotech.ponder.petri_dish_scene_1: 史莱姆培养皿可以用来培养拟态生物
在培养皿中放入活体构件...
然后通入液态活体史莱姆...
液态活体史莱姆会模仿附近的生物并长大
被模仿的生物血量上限越高，所需的液态活体史莱姆越多
zh_cn.create_biotech.ponder.petri_dish_s_e7373: 击杀拟态或仿生生物不会掉落物品，而会分裂为活体史莱姆
与拟态村民交易也只能买到黏液球
对拟态生物施加再生效果...
再使用鼓风机和灵魂营火进行“缠魂”
即可将拟态生物转化为普通生物

en_us.create_biotech.ponder.petri_dish_scene_1: Slime Petri Dishes can be used to cultivate mimic creatures
Insert a Living Mechanism into the Petri Dish...
Then pipe in Liquid Living Slime...
The Liquid Living Slime mimics a nearby mob and grows
Mobs with more maximum health require more Liquid Living Slime to mimic
en_us.create_biotech.ponder.petri_dish_s_e7373: Mimic and bionic creatures drop no items when killed, but split into living Slimes
Trading with mimic villagers only yields Slimeballs as well
Apply Regeneration to a mimic creature...
Then use an Encased Fan and Soul Campfire to haunt it
This transforms the mimic creature into a normal mob

zh_cn.create_biotech.ponder.power_belt_connect: 动力传送带会在有生物在其上方运动时产生应力
上方生物运动的越快，产生的转速越高，应力越高
多个实体产生的应力会叠加，但是转速不会
使用固定的钓竿，让动物为你工作

en_us.create_biotech.ponder.power_belt_connect: The Power Belt generates stress when creatures move across it.
The faster creatures move above it, the higher the speed and stress it produces.
Stress from multiple entities stacks, but speed does not.
Use a Fixed Fishing Rod to put animals to work.

zh_cn.create_biotech.ponder.schrodingers_cat.t: 薛定谔的猫会在其背后随机输出红石信号
其间隔时间和输出模式（持续信号/脉冲信号）可以在侧面配置

en_us.create_biotech.ponder.schrodingers_cat.t: Schrodinger's Cat randomly outputs redstone signals from its back.
Its interval and output mode (sustained or pulse) can be configured from the side.

zh_cn.create_biotech.ponder.shulker_packager.t: 潜影打包机和普通打包机的工作方式类似
不同的是，它会在短距离内自动传送其中的包裹
放置潜影打包机前，右键任意机械臂输出点或打包机以选择输出目标
收到请求后，潜影打包机会将包裹传送到选定的目标
潜影打包机适用于短距离传输，长距离传输可以使用悦灵驿站、货物蛙港、火车与邮箱等
查看它们的思索界面以了解它们的行为

en_us.create_biotech.ponder.shulker_packager.t: Shulker Packagers work much like regular Packagers.
The difference is that they automatically teleport their packages over short distances.
Before placing a Shulker Packager, right-click any Mechanical Arm output point or Packager to select an output target.
After receiving a request, the Shulker Packager teleports the package to its selected target.
Shulker Packagers are suited for short-range transport; for long-range transport, use Cargo Allay Stations, Package Frogports, Trains, Postboxes, and similar options.
Check their Ponder screens to learn how they behave.

zh_cn.create_biotech.ponder.shulker_teleporter: 潜影传送站可以在两个站点之间传送玩家、生物或掉落物
在界面中设置本机地址和目标地址
闭合完成后，站内实体会被传送到目标站点

en_us.create_biotech.ponder.shulker_teleporter: Shulker Teleport Stations can teleport players, creatures, or dropped items between two stations.
Set this station's address and its target address in the interface.
Once sealed, entities inside are teleported to the target station.

zh_cn.create_biotech.ponder.slime_belt_connect: 史莱姆传送带可以像一般传送带一样传输物品
不同的是，物品不会在传送带末端被抛出，而是会继续运动到传送带背面
史莱姆传送带还可以竖直传动物品
相连的史莱姆传送带可以形成一个回环

en_us.create_biotech.ponder.slime_belt_connect: The Slime Belt can transport items like a normal belt.
The difference is that items are not thrown off the end, but continue moving onto the back side of the belt.
The Slime Belt can also move items vertically.
Connected Slime Belts can form a loop.

zh_cn.create_biotech.ponder.slime_clutch.text_: 史莱姆离合器会在输入应力不支持驱动整个应力网络时自动断开，而不影响网络的其他部分
并在应力充足时自动恢复

en_us.create_biotech.ponder.slime_clutch.text_: The Slime Clutch automatically disengages when the input stress cannot drive the entire kinetic network, without affecting the rest of the network.
It automatically re-engages when enough stress is available.

zh_cn.create_biotech.ponder.spider_assembly_ta: 蜘蛛装配台可以执行序列装配配方
右键打开界面，在第一行放入装配所需要的机器...
在第二行放入装配所需原料

en_us.create_biotech.ponder.spider_assembly_ta: The Spider Assembly Table can perform Sequenced Assembly recipes.
Right-click to open its interface, then place the required machines in the first row...
Place the required ingredients in the second row.

zh_cn.create_biotech.ponder.squid_printer_scen: 这是一个简单的附魔流水线
在侧面标记一本附魔书...
它会将下方的书加工为附魔书（复印本）
无论是否在工作，打印机都需要输入水来保证鱿鱼存活
zh_cn.create_biotech.ponder.squid_printer_s_89: 它可以将附魔书（复印本）附魔为可以使用的附魔书
通过经验泵向其输送附魔所需要的经验
附魔书的总等级越高，所需的经验越多，时间越长

en_us.create_biotech.ponder.squid_printer_scen: This is a simple enchantment production line.
Mark an enchanted book on the side...
It will process the book below into an Enchanted Book (Copy).
Whether it is working or not, the printer needs a water supply to keep the squid alive.
en_us.create_biotech.ponder.squid_printer_s_89: This is an Evoker Enchanting Chamber.
It can turn copied enchanted books into usable enchanted books.
Supply it with the experience needed for enchanting through an Experience Pump.
The higher the total enchantment level, the more experience and time it requires.

zh_cn.create_biotech.ponder.universal_joint.te: 史莱姆万向节可以在相近的任意两个点之间传播应力
另一节点必须位于连接范围内。结构移动会拉伸轴体；接近极限时逐渐变为史莱姆离合器的过载色，过度拉伸后断裂。

en_us.create_biotech.ponder.universal_joint.te: The Universal Joint can transmit rotational force between any two nearby points.
The other node must be within range. Moving structures stretch the shaft; it shifts to the clutch overload colour and snaps when overextended.
